utterances.speaker: Therapist
utterances.text: Good to see you, David. How have things been this week?

utterances.speaker: Patient
utterances.text: Pretty good actually. I went hiking with my family over the weekend. It was nice to disconnect from work.

utterances.speaker: Therapist
utterances.text: That sounds great. How did you feel during and after the hike?

utterances.speaker: Patient
utterances.text: Relaxed. My kids loved it. We're planning to do it again next weekend. I've also been reading more.

utterances.speaker: Patient
utterances.text: A biography of Teddy Roosevelt. He had a fascinating life. I like learning about historical figures.

utterances.speaker: Therapist
utterances.text: Sounds engaging. Let's check in on your goals from last week.
